items.stem: An executive asks the RAG chatbot a finance question they are not authorised to see. What design prevents leakage?

options.text: Document-level security trimming that honours Entra ID permission metadata at query time
options.rationale: Correct: retrieval must enforce access control so only authorised content is returned.

options.text: A longer system prompt asking the model to be careful
options.rationale: Prompts do not enforce document permissions.

options.text: Increasing the number of retrieved chunks
options.rationale: Returning more content worsens the leak.
Ranking settings do not control authorisation.

items.explanation: Correct: retrieval must enforce access control so only authorised content is returned.

items.stem: Which TWO are accurate about Azure AI Search for RAG per the documentation? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Indexers pull from data sources and can drive skillsets for chunking and vectorisation
options.rationale: Correct: the indexer plus skillset pipeline ingests and enriches content.

options.text: A remote SharePoint knowledge source queries SharePoint without building a search index
options.rationale: Correct: the remote knowledge source queries SharePoint directly and enforces its permission model.

options.text: RAG eliminates the need for any relevance tuning
options.rationale: Relevance tuning (hybrid search, semantic ranking) remains important.

options.text: Renaming a SharePoint folder has no effect on incremental indexing
options.rationale: A renamed folder breaks incremental indexing and is treated as new content.

items.explanation: Correct: the indexer plus skillset pipeline ingests and enriches content.

items.stem: For a scenario that must avoid replicating sensitive documents into a search index, which option fits best?

options.text: A remote SharePoint knowledge source that queries content in place
options.rationale: Correct: the remote source queries SharePoint directly with no index copy and honours its permissions.

options.text: Copying all documents into a public blob container
options.rationale: That replicates and exposes sensitive data.

options.text: Emailing the documents to the model
options.rationale: That is neither a retrieval pattern nor secure.
Removing permissions defeats the security requirement.

items.explanation: Correct: the remote source queries SharePoint directly with no index copy and honours its permissions.
